messages:
alex: Quick check — PR #52411 is ready from my side but needs runtime + security signoff before I schedule a merge. Changes: small prefetch TTL tweak, a guard for cold-KV fallback, and a flag to throttle prefetch during peak. Link: https://git.redwood/pr/52411 :eyes:
toni: Can you paste the perf snapshot and the canary window you're aiming for?
alex: Perf numbers: 
```
p95 latency: 21ms -> 22ms (worst-case cold path)
throughput: +0.5% under synthetic load
error rate: unchanged
```
Planning a brief canary during tomorrow's 10:00-11:00 PST low-traffic slot.
sam: I can own runtime review and canary monitoring. I'll watch p95/traces for the cold path and confirm kv fallback behavior. @alex pls add me to the canary notify list. :+1:
jay: Security quick Qs: does this touch any auth/headers or KMS calls? Anything that changes data movement?
alex: No KMS/auth. Only internal cache/eviction flags. No new secrets.
sec-bot: Automated scan report for PR #52411: no high/critical findings, 3 low-level lints (docs/txt) — see pipeline output.
jay: OK, I'll give security signoff pending sec-bot details. If the canary exposes any stale-reads we should have rollback ready.
infra-oncall: Heads up — depending on canary telemetry we might need to revert the throttling flag quickly. Who is the rollback owner?
sam: I'll be rollback steward during the canary window. If I don't ack within 5m of an alert, tag me again and infra can revert the flag.
toni: Sounds good. Alex, leave the merge blocked until sam and jay post thumbs up here. Also add a small smoke test to the canary to validate KV hit-rate > 95% for warm flows.
alex: Added smoke test and canary notify list with @sam, @jay, and infra-oncall. Will hold merge. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
